newsitem.title: USA: Intl Imaging Q4 to be below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Intl Imaging Q4 to be below expectations.

text.p: International Imaging Materials Inc said on Monday that its earnings per share for the fourth quarter ending March 31, 1997, will be approximately $0.28 to $0.30, which is below expectations and its results in last year's fourth quarter.
International Imaging reported earnings per share of $0.34 on sales of $24.2 million in last year's fourth quarter.
Analysts had expected earnings of $0.37 a share for the quarter, according to First Call.
International Imaging said it expects to report fourth quarter revenues of $27 million.
International Imaging said that its results were hurt by its conventional color ribbon business, which fell short of expectations.
